g.desc: MS5351M: CLK0 -> FPGA_CLK (RPLL_T_in pin 33), CLK1 -> MCU_CLK (STM32 HSE bypass),

g.desc: CLK2 -> FPGA pin 34 (spare clock / beat mode). One 100 nF each at VDD and VDDO.

g.text: Pin plan (UG842): Bank1 = TAP0..15 (COS3502 outputs, LVCMOS33 in), SPI slave, FPGA_CLK;

g.desc: Pin plan (UG842): Bank1 = TAP0..15 (COS3502 outputs, LVCMOS33 in), SPI slave, FPGA_CLK;

g.text: Bank0 = strobes (OSER10, pairs IOT16A/B and IOT17A/B), ADC_TRIG, COARSE (GCLKT_0), config, JTAG.

g.desc: Bank0 = strobes (OSER10, pairs IOT16A/B and IOT17A/B), ADC_TRIG, COARSE (GCLKT_0), config, JTAG.

g.desc: Configuration: internal flash (autoboot), MODE1=MODE0=0 via 4.7k pull-downs.
